items.title: File Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats beim Finanzamt Beispielhain eingehen; die Frist beginnt mit dem Tag nach der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter is dated (and thus posted) 05.06.2025, a Thursday. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, so the Bekanntgabefiktion is the 4th calendar day after posting: 05.06.2025 + 4 days = 09.06.2025 (Monday). For tax offices, if that day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO), but 09.06.2025 is a normal Monday, so Bekanntgabe = 09.06.2025. Per §355 Abs.1 AO / §108 AO with §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB, the one-month objection period runs from the day after Bekanntgabe and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 09.07.2025 (Wednesday). This date is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so it stands as the final day (§108 Abs.3 AO would otherwise shift it).
